title: 电动车替代见顶？：中国原油采购回归，但短期没有大单
speaker: Gareth Nicholson

segments.en: Walk us through the China buying as well. Because that was what was, as you say, that's the biggest change that you've seen in this market. We've seen it in the oil demand perk up in August.
segments.zh: 也请讲讲中国的采购。因为正如你所说，这是你在市场上看到的最大变化。我们在8月原油需求回升中看到了这一点。

segments.en: How sustainable do you think the sort of China buying is going to be? China has done a lot of, you know, implement a lot of measures to reduce its oil use
segments.zh: 你认为中国的这种采购可持续性如何？中国已经做了很多，你知道，实施了很多措施来减少石油使用。

segments.en: in order to, you know, make themself their comforted position in oil and oil product infantry. But I think there's a limit for demand destruction.
segments.zh: 以便在石油和成品油方面建立舒适的头寸。但我认为需求破坏是有限度的。

segments.en: So you have more EVs on the roads. You have more machine powered by electricity, right? And, you know, we are now down to a point that that demand destruction one of is pretty much done.
segments.zh: 所以路上有更多电动车。有更多机器由电力驱动，对吧？而且，我们现在已经到达一个点，需求破坏基本上已经完成。

segments.en: So going forward if, you know, China doesn't have enough oil from the Middle East. And also in terms of the oil program market is still getting type because of damage in, you know,
segments.zh: 所以往前看，如果中国没有足够来自中东的石油。而且就石油计划市场而言，由于世界其他地区的损害，市场仍然紧张，

segments.en: other part of the world for refining capacity and shortage in oil product. You know, China will have to build up their infantry at a comfortable level.
segments.zh: 其他地区的炼油能力以及成品油短缺。你知道，中国将不得不建立舒适的头寸水平。

segments.en: So in short, I would say that they will come back to the market to buy crude oil products to maintain a comfortable level.
segments.zh: 简而言之，我会说他们会回到市场购买原油产品以维持舒适的水平。

segments.en: But I don't think that would be a massive buying in the near term.
segments.zh: 但我认为短期内不会出现大规模采购。
